ableton_cache.what: %APPDATA%\Ableton: Live's Preferences, database, crash reports and unlock data.
ableton_cache.used_for: Live reads preferences and authorization from here.
ableton_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folder.

aftereffects_cache.what: Adobe's shared Media Cache Files (conformed audio, indexes) used by After Effects, Premiere Pro and Media Encoder.
aftereffects_cache.used_for: Adobe apps rebuild these when the footage is next opened; Adobe offers 'Clean Database & Cache' for the same files.
aftereffects_cache.risk: Projects open slower while media is re-conformed and re-indexed. Footage and projects are not here.
aftereffects_cache.before_cleaning: Close After Effects, Premiere Pro and Media Encoder first.
aftereffects_cache.catalog_concern: Same paths as premiere_cache (duplicate). After Effects' Disk Cache is separate and not listed.

amd_dvr_cache.used_for: Temporary recording buffer; can hold a just-saved clip.
amd_dvr_cache.risk: A clip not yet moved could be lost.

amd_radeon_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. AMD log folders; one path has a stray space ('AMD\ Radeon') and the AGESA path is not a known AMD location.
amd_radeon_cache.risk: Only past diagnostics are lost: support or a crash investigation can no longer read what happened before the cleanup.
amd_radeon_cache.catalog_concern: Likely matches nothing. Correctly avoids %LOCALAPPDATA%\AMD\DxCache/DxcCache/VkCache (game shader caches -- deleting them causes stutter).

audacity_cache.what: Audacity's temporary folder. In Audacity 3 the temporary/unsaved project data (SessionData) is where crash recovery finds unsaved work.
audacity_cache.used_for: Audacity deletes its temp project files itself on a normal close; after a crash they are what 'Recover Selected' restores.
audacity_cache.risk: Deleting after a crash, or while Audacity runs, destroys recoverable unsaved recordings.
audacity_cache.before_cleaning: Close Audacity normally first, and recover any crashed project before cleaning.
audacity_cache.catalog_concern: Should be 'caution': this temp folder can hold the only copy of an unsaved or crashed recording.

blender_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. Per-version 'cache' folders under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Blender Foundation\Blender.
blender_cache.used_for: Rebuildable caches for that Blender version.
blender_cache.risk: Slower first use of the cached feature.
blender_cache.catalog_concern: Label says 'render output temp and autosave' -- Blender's autosaves and quit.blend go to the temp directory, not here. Never target %APPDATA%\Blender Foundation (config, scripts, add-ons).

blender_full_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. Blender per-version cache and tmp folders.
blender_full_cache.used_for: tmp can be configured as Blender's temp directory, where autosaves and quit.blend live.
blender_full_cache.risk: If tmp is used as Blender's temp folder, the autosave/quit.blend recovery files are lost.
blender_full_cache.before_cleaning: Close Blender; recover any autosave first.
blender_full_cache.catalog_concern: The 'tmp' path may hold autosave recovery files; caution, not safe.

camtasia_cache.what: TechSmith Camtasia's whole data folders (recordings in progress, preferences, library).
camtasia_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folders.

capture_one_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. Cache, logs and thumbnails folders under Capture One's app data. Capture One documents its real cache as living INSIDE each catalog or session.
capture_one_cache.used_for: Capture One: deleting the Cache does not remove images or adjustments; thumbnails and previews are rebuilt.
capture_one_cache.risk: Slow browsing while previews regenerate; lost logs.
capture_one_cache.catalog_concern: These %APPDATA% paths may not be where the cache is. Never target a catalog's .cocatalogdb or a session's Settings folders.

cubase_cache.what: Steinberg's whole data folders (Cubase preferences, key commands, templates).
cubase_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folders.

davinci_cache.what: DaVinci Resolve logs, CacheClip (render cache), OptimizedMedia and Render Cache folders.
davinci_cache.used_for: Render cache and optimized media are regenerable from source footage; Resolve has Playback > Delete Render Cache for the same purpose.
davinci_cache.risk: Playback is choppy until caches/optimized media are re-rendered (can take hours); support logs lost. Source media is unaffected.
davinci_cache.catalog_concern: Resolve's cache location is per project (Working Folders); these %LOCALAPPDATA% paths may not be the real one.

deezer_cache.what: Deezer's whole data folder, including offline downloads and sign-in.
deezer_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folder.

emby_cache.what: Emby Server cache (image cache) and transcoding temp segments. On Windows Emby uses %APPDATA%\Emby-Server\programdata, so these paths may not exist.
emby_cache.used_for: Transcoding segments are temporary and normally cleaned by Emby; cached images are re-generated.
emby_cache.risk: An active stream breaks if its segments are deleted; images regenerate.
emby_cache.before_cleaning: Stop playback or the Emby service first.
emby_cache.catalog_concern: Never widen to programdata\data or metadata (library database and artwork).

ffmpeg_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. Folders named ffmpeg and MediaFire inside %TEMP%. FFmpeg itself has no standard temp folder.
ffmpeg_cache.used_for: Leftover temporary files of whatever tool created them.
ffmpeg_cache.risk: If a conversion is running, its output could be lost.
ffmpeg_cache.before_cleaning: Make sure no conversion/download is running.
ffmpeg_cache.catalog_concern: The MediaFire folder is not FFmpeg-related; the label is misleading.

filmora_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folders.

flstudio_cache.what: FL Studio's FL64 folder and Image-Line app data (settings, autosaves, plugin database).

foobar_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. A 'cache' folder in foobar2000's profile (foobar2000 v2 uses %APPDATA%\foobar2000-v2).
foobar_cache.catalog_concern: Never widen to the profile root: it holds the configuration, library and playlists.

greenshot_cache.what: Greenshot's settings folder (Greenshot.ini) and plugin data.
greenshot_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: settings, not cache.

handbrake_cache.what: HandBrake activity logs; 'cache' is not a documented HandBrake folder.
handbrake_cache.risk: Only past diagnostics are lost: support or a crash investigation can no longer read what happened before the cleanup.
handbrake_cache.catalog_concern: Same folder holds settings.json and presets.json -- never widen to the root.

illustrator_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. Cache/Temp under %APPDATA%\Adobe\Illustrator*. Illustrator's real folder is 'Adobe Illustrator NN Settings', so this pattern probably matches nothing.
illustrator_cache.used_for: The label says it contains 'saved recovery data' -- Illustrator's DataRecovery folder is the only copy of unsaved work after a crash.
illustrator_cache.risk: If it ever matches DataRecovery, unsaved artwork after a crash is lost.
illustrator_cache.before_cleaning: Close Illustrator; recover documents after a crash first.
illustrator_cache.catalog_concern: A 'safe' entry described as holding recovery data contradicts itself. Keep DataRecovery out explicitly.

infuse_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folder.

intel_graphics_cache.what: Intel graphics logs and a shader cache folder. Intel's driver shader cache is reported at %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Intel\ShaderCache.
intel_graphics_cache.used_for: Compiled shaders are regenerated; expect a brief slowdown the next time games or apps load.
intel_graphics_cache.risk: Stutter / slower loads in games until shaders recompile; lost logs.
intel_graphics_cache.before_cleaning: Close games and graphics apps first.
intel_graphics_cache.catalog_concern: Shader cache should be 'caution' (rebuild stutter); the LOCALAPPDATA path may not be the real one.

jellyfin_cache.what: Jellyfin Server's cache folder (resized images, transcode temp, other temp data); on Windows its data lives under %LOCALAPPDATA%\jellyfin.
jellyfin_cache.used_for: Transcode segments are temporary; image cache is regenerated.
jellyfin_cache.risk: An active stream breaks; images regenerate.
jellyfin_cache.before_cleaning: Stop playback or the Jellyfin server first.
jellyfin_cache.catalog_concern: Never widen to the data, metadata or config folders (library database, artwork, trickplay, users).

kodi_cache.what: Kodi's temp folder (%APPDATA%\Kodi\cache = special://temp) and a 'thumbnails' folder.
kodi_cache.used_for: Temp files are recreated. Kodi's real artwork cache is userdata\Thumbnails, indexed by Textures13.db.
kodi_cache.risk: Temp: none known. Artwork cache: deleted without its database, Kodi shows missing artwork.
kodi_cache.catalog_concern: %APPDATA%\Kodi\thumbnails does not exist; if corrected to userdata\Thumbnails it must be deleted together with Database\Textures13.db.

mpv_cache.what: mpv's config folder (mpv.conf, input.conf, scripts, watch_later).

nvidia_display_cache.what: NVIDIA driver shader caches: DXCache (DirectX) and GLCache (OpenGL/Vulkan).
nvidia_display_cache.used_for: Compiled game shaders; Epic's Fortnite guide clears DXCache only to fix shader stutter, warning the first match will stutter while shaders rebuild.
nvidia_display_cache.risk: Stutter and longer loads in every game until shaders recompile. Nothing is lost permanently.
nvidia_display_cache.before_cleaning: Close all games first; delete only when shader corruption is suspected.
nvidia_display_cache.catalog_concern: Should be 'caution' (rebuild stutter). The label's 'DRS database' (driver profiles, in ProgramData) is not here and must stay untouched.

nvidia_experience_cache.what: GeForce Experience's whole data folder (CefCache plus settings).
nvidia_experience_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole folder; only CefCache would be a cache.

nvidia_geforce_cache.what: GeForce Experience logs and its update download staging (UpdateTemp).
nvidia_geforce_cache.used_for: Logs are diagnostics; UpdateTemp is re-downloaded.
nvidia_geforce_cache.risk: Lost logs; an update may download again.
nvidia_geforce_cache.catalog_concern: Label mentions a 'screenshot folder' -- captures are user data; none is listed.

obs_cache.what: OBS Studio log files (%APPDATA%\obs-studio\logs). The OBS\logs and OBS\crashreports paths are not OBS's (crash reports are in obs-studio\crashes).
obs_cache.used_for: Logs are what the OBS forum asks for when troubleshooting; new ones are written each session.
obs_cache.risk: Only past diagnostics are lost: support or a crash investigation can no longer read what happened before the cleanup.
obs_cache.catalog_concern: Label promises 'recording temp, replay buffer' -- recordings are user files and the replay buffer is in memory; not targeted. Never widen to obs-studio\basic (scenes, profiles, stream keys).

peertube_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folder.

photoshop_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. Cache under Adobe\Photoshop\* (Photoshop's folders are named 'Adobe Photoshop <year>', so this probably matches nothing).
photoshop_cache.used_for: Photoshop's scratch files are 'Photoshop Temp*' files in %TEMP% and are released on close.
photoshop_cache.catalog_concern: Label says 'history' -- AutoRecover (in 'Adobe Photoshop <year>\AutoRecover') holds crash recovery and must never be targeted.

plex_cache.what: Plex Media Server's whole data folder: library database, metadata, artwork, preferences (and the server's identity).
plex_cache.risk: The library and server setup are lost; the server must be set up again.
plex_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: only its Cache and Codecs subfolders would be rebuildable.

premiere_cache.what: Adobe's shared Media Cache Files and Peak Files (.pek audio waveforms, .cfa conformed audio).
premiere_cache.used_for: Rebuilt when media is next used; Premiere can delete them automatically by age or size.
premiere_cache.risk: Projects open slower while audio is re-conformed and waveforms redrawn.
premiere_cache.before_cleaning: Close Premiere Pro, After Effects and Media Encoder first.
premiere_cache.catalog_concern: Label says 'auto-save' -- Premiere's Auto-Save folder sits beside the project and is not listed, correctly.

qobuz_cache.what: Qobuz's whole data folder, including offline tracks.

reaper_cache.what: REAPER's resource folders (reaper.ini, configs, scripts, project backups).

sharex_cache.what: ShareX's folder: screenshots, history, settings and uploader credentials.
sharex_cache.risk: Lost screenshots, history and uploader keys.
sharex_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: screenshots and credentials.

snagit_cache.what: Snagit's data folder (library of captures, settings).

spotify_app_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. Cache and logs under %APPDATA%\Spotify (where the desktop app installs itself; its main cache is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Spotify).
spotify_app_cache.used_for: Cached song parts are re-downloaded when played.
spotify_app_cache.risk: More streaming data use for a while; lost logs.
spotify_app_cache.catalog_concern: Never widen to %APPDATA%\Spotify itself (the program and its prefs).

spotify_cache.what: Spotify's local streaming cache (parts of songs/podcasts already played).
spotify_cache.used_for: Spotify uses it to play without lag; its own Settings > Storage > Clear cache does the same. Re-filled as you listen.
spotify_cache.risk: Songs re-download when played. Spotify stores downloads for offline play in its storage location too, so deleting folders by hand may remove offline downloads.
spotify_cache.before_cleaning: Quit Spotify first; prefer Spotify's own Clear cache button.

spotify_full_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling as a duplicate is fine; the label ('users') suggested profile data.

stremio_cache_full.what: Stremio's whole data folder (add-ons, settings, sign-in, cache).
stremio_cache_full.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folder.

tidal_cache.what: TIDAL's whole data folder, including offline tracks and sign-in.
tidal_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: whole app folder.

vegas_cache.what: Not documented by the vendor. A 'VEGASTemp' folder. VEGAS Pro writes its temporary files AND its 5-minute autosaves (*.autosave.veg) to the 'Temporary files folder' set in Preferences.
vegas_cache.used_for: Autosaves are deleted on a normal exit; after a crash they are the recovery copy.
vegas_cache.risk: After a crash, the autosave recovery copy of the project is lost; rendering temp files in use break a render.
vegas_cache.before_cleaning: Close VEGAS normally; recover a crashed project first.
vegas_cache.catalog_concern: The label itself says 'autosave' -- that cannot be 'safe'.

vlc_cache.what: VLC's settings folder (vlcrc, media library, recent list).

vst_cache.what: VST3 folders. Real VST3 plugins are installed under Common Files\VST3.
vst_cache.catalog_concern: Disabling was right: VST3 folders hold plugins, not caches.
